about_the_game:
One bot. Endless waves. Just one rule: never stop moving.

Dive into Bot Rush, a fast-paced arcade shooter where you control a small round robot facing relentless waves of enemies charging in straight lines. Your goal? Wipe them out, upgrade your abilities, and survive long enough to beat the level—or die trying.

Key Features

Simple, addictive gameplay
Enemies come straight at you. You dodge, shoot, and fight to stay alive. Easy to pick up, hard to master.

Dynamic upgrades and passives
Every milestone gives you a choice of powerful passive boosts. Build unique combinations with every run.

Non-stop action and power scaling
The longer you survive, the stronger the enemies—and the more powerful you become. Every second counts.

Futuristic setting with a Japanese urban flair
Battle through stylized city streets inspired by neon-lit Asian metropolises.

Endless Mode for high-score chasers
No limit, no mercy. See how long you can last when the waves never end.

Easy to learn, impossible to put down

Bot Rush delivers quick, intense sessions perfect for short bursts or extended play. Whether you have five minutes or an hour, you're always one click away from full-on action and satisfying progression.

And if you're down soldier, just keep up!
